result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: missing Orders tab icon, lower content clipped by bottom navigation, and truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: Bottom navigation 'Orders' tab has no visible icon while Home, Search and Profile all show icons above their labels
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon and ensure it uses the same size, color and inactive state as the other tabs

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' pizza image is flush against and clipped by the bottom tab bar with no bottom padding or safe-area spacing
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards scroll fully into view and are not obscured

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' truncates mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the screen edge
issues.suggestion: Use proper truncation with ellipsis or ensure card width allows full name wrapping on two lines instead of cutting a letter
